operations.body:
schemaVersion: archcontext.node/v2
id: capability.public-surface.action-commands
kind: capability
name: Action Commands
status: active
summary: Defines the user-facing action command skill surface and its evaluation boundary.
responsibilities:
  - Own action command assets and their behavior/evaluation contracts.
source:
  include:
    - "assets/skill-commands/**"
  entrypoints:
    - id: entrypoint.action-commands.primary
      path: "src/cli/commands/init.ts"
      symbols:
        - name: "runInit"
          sinks:
            - id: sink.action-commands.primary
              path: "src/cli/commands/init.ts"
              symbol: "installExternalSkills"
extensions:
  contractFiles:
    agents: "AGENTS.md"
    claude: "CLAUDE.md"
  lspProfile: "typescript-lsp"
  verification:
    - "bun test tests/action-command-skills.test.ts"
    - "bun run benchmark:skills --dry-run"

schemaVersion: archcontext.node/v2
id: component.action-commands.primary
kind: component
name: "Action Command Installer"
status: active
parent: capability.public-surface.action-commands
summary: "Executes the reviewed install action command skills boundary."

schemaVersion: archcontext.relation/v1
id: relation.action-commands.primary
kind: calls
source: capability.public-surface.action-commands
target: component.action-commands.primary
intent: "Install action command skills"

schemaVersion: archcontext.flow/v1
id: flow.action-commands.primary
capabilityId: capability.public-surface.action-commands
name: "Install action command skills"
applicability: required
participants:
  - id: capability
    nodeId: capability.public-surface.action-commands
  - id: component
    nodeId: component.action-commands.primary
steps: []
outcomes:
  - id: success
    kind: success
    label: "Install action command skills completes"
    steps:
      - id: invoke-success
        from: capability
        to: component
        label: "Invoke Action Command Installer"
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.action-commands.primary
          sourceSymbol: "runInit"
          sinkId: sink.action-commands.primary
    terminal:
      participant: capability
      label: Return success receipt
  - id: error
    kind: error
    label: "Install action command skills is rejected or fails"
    steps:
      - id: invoke-error
        from: capability
        to: component
        label: "Propagate Action Command Installer failure"
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.action-commands.primary
          sourceSymbol: "runInit"
          sinkId: sink.action-commands.primary
    terminal:
      participant: capability
      label: Return typed failure

      path: "src/cli/commands/adoption-plan.ts"

              symbol: "applyAdoptionPlan"

    claude: "CLAUDE.md"
  lspProfile: "typescript-lsp"
  verification:

schemaVersion: archcontext.node/v2

name: Root Router
status: active

    - "README.md"
    - "AGENTS.md"
    - "CLAUDE.md"

              symbol: "runAdoptionPlan"

schemaVersion: archcontext.node/v2
id: capability.workflow-engine.inspection-migration
kind: capability
name: Inspection And Migration
status: active
summary: Inspects repository state and executes explicit initialization or migration plans.
responsibilities:
  - Own project inspection, scaffold creation, and bounded migration behavior.
source:
  include:
    - "scripts/inspect-project-state.ts"
    - "scripts/create-project-dirs.sh"
    - "scripts/init-project.sh"
    - "scripts/lib/**"
  entrypoints:
    - id: entrypoint.inspection-migration.primary
      path: "src/cli/commands/init.ts"
      symbols:
        - name: "runInit"
          sinks:
            - id: sink.inspection-migration.primary
              path: "src/cli/commands/init.ts"
              symbol: "runProcess"
extensions:
  contractFiles:
    agents: "scripts/AGENTS.md"
    claude: "scripts/CLAUDE.md"
  lspProfile: "typescript-lsp"
  verification:
    - "bun test tests/migration-script.test.ts tests/create-project-dirs.runtime.test.ts tests/workflow-contract.test.ts"
    - "bun src/cli/index.ts init --repo . --dry-run"
